entries.b54908c885aefe2b: Dispatch, Contract Work and Outsourced Operations
entries.bce9bc05745a37c1: Staffing and HR services are a group of businesses that connect companies with workers and develop workers' skills. They include dispatching design engineers and office staff, supporting job changes and recruitment, undertaking outsourced operations, and training and education for companies. There are also services for companies and people overseas, in addition to those in Japan.
